victim: The Starfall Mask and the finale audience
motive: Dev feared the producer would pull the finale if they heard the original mask’s clasp had cracked.
method: He returned the original to the prop bay at 18:57, moved the replica to the stage-left wing at 18:59, told Sana not to inform the producer until after the show, and later moved the original into Repair Case 2 without logging the reason.
explanation: A concealed repair decision, not a permanent theft. The original is found in Repair Case 2 once Dev admits the unlogged move.

timeline.event: Original present on the prop stand
Original last independently seen at stage-left; Nikhil goes onstage
Dev returns the original to the prop bay
Dev tells Sana to use the backup and not update the producer
Dev moves the replica to the stage-left wing
CUE-17 plans the original but shows the replica
Post-finale check finds the replica on the stand
Dev moves the original to Repair Case 2

causal_chain: The original’s clasp snagged in rehearsal and Dev took it back to the prop bay.
Dev put the replica forward and told Sana to keep the producer out of the loop.
The cue ran on schedule with the wrong item because nobody else knew.
The original was moved into a repair case and only disclosed after the mismatch was raised.

resolution.motive: He wanted the finale to go ahead and feared the producer would cancel it over a cracked clasp.
resolution.method: He used the backup mask for the reveal and kept the original in a repair case, without logging the move.
chain: Dev holds the prop custody duty (RA01).
He handled the original’s 18:57 return and the replica’s 18:59 move, and the later repair-case move.
His 18:58 message tells Sana to hold back the producer; his 19:16 message admits the move.
Nikhil, Kavya and Arjun have no movement of either mask.
